questions: What is the difference between HTTP and HTTPS?
What is the difference between frontend and backend development?

weak_answers.question: What is the difference between HTTP and HTTPS?
weak_answers.user_answer: HTTP is less secure while HTTPS is more secure
weak_answers.expected_answer: HTTPS uses encryption through TLS to protect data exchanged between a client and a server, while HTTP does not provide that transport encryption.

weak_answers.question: What is the difference between frontend and backend development?
weak_answers.user_answer: Frontend involves user Interface design and User Experience
weak_answers.expected_answer: Frontend development focuses on the parts of an application users interact with, while backend development handles server-side logic, data processing, and services.
